title: Thea receipt v1
description: One verify run as a record that verifies from its own bytes. A verdict is PASS only when every check PASSED and the policy was read from the base commit; NOT RUN and FAIL are never a pass; SKIP is counted apart and is never a pass. Separate from tools/atlas-output.schema.json, which is the frozen --json contract and is not changed by this file.

receipt_id.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of every other field. Recomputed by the verifier; a mismatch is a tampered or mis-copied receipt.

base_commit.description: The commit the policy was read from, or null when no base could be resolved (a FAIL finding).

input_digest.description: The tree digest the checks ran over (verify.input_digest). Two runs of one tree carry the same value.

allOf.description: A PASS verdict needs a pinned policy digest: a receipt with no policy to pin to is never a pass.

source.description: The policy is always read from the base commit, never from the PR head.

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of verification_policy as read from base_commit; null when no base was read.

why.description: The cause, recorded for any state other than PASS. Absent on a PASS so a re-used proof and a fresh one read the same.
